item.title: Troika’s classic D&D RPG The Temple of Elemental Evil returns with over 1,000 fixes
item.description: SNEG Ltd has released The Temple of Elemental Evil on Steam. The classic D&D RPG returns with over 1,000 community fixes and enhancements included.

item.title: New Shadow Council launches to monitor UK games industry ethics
item.description: The UK Games Industry Shadow Council (UKGISC) has launched to demand transparency and accountability in the games sector. Chair Phil Harris explains the new watchdog's mission.

item.title: Moonbase Alpha returns: Space: 1999 Core Rulebook is out now
item.description: The Space: 1999 roleplaying game is out now. Modiphius brings the cult classic sci-fi series to the tabletop using the 2d20 system.

item.title: WotC Asks for DM feedback after delaying key VTT features
item.description: Wizards of the Coast has delayed D&D Maps features including 3D dice to 2026 and scrapped the Campaign Console, asking DMs for feedback on what to build next.

item.title: Judge Dredd hits the High Street: Rebellion partners with Forbidden Planet
item.description: Rebellion has launched a new range of 2000 AD merchandise exclusively with Forbidden Planet. Get your fix of Judge Dredd gear in-store and online now.

item.title: First teaser trailer for ‘Supergirl’ gives us a flavour for Milly Alcock’s woman of tomorrow
item.description: The first teaser trailer for DCU's Supergirl has dropped, and it's clear that what we're looking at is a totally different animal from what we're used to seeing. This feels different... fresh, fun and a little bit feral. And we like it.

item.title: WotC’s sci-fi epic Exodus pushes to 2027 with new cinematic trailer
item.description: The wait for Exodus might be longer than expected, with a new trailer pinning down an early 2027 release.

item.title: Yakuza creator returns to Kabukicho with Gang of Dragon
item.description: Toshihiro Nagoshi reveals Gang of Dragon, a new action-adventure game starring Ma Dong-seok (Don Lee) set in the heart of Tokyo's Kabukicho district.

item.title: Tricia Helfer cast as the lead in Warlock, a dark fantasy D&D action game
item.description: Wizards of the Coast and Invoke Studios have announced Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons, a third-person action game starring Tricia Helfer, set for a 2027 release.

item.title: Routinely Itemised: RPG #339
item.description: Australian legislation blocks teens from D&D on Twitch, though VTTs remain accessible. Meanwhile, Jason Carl departs World of Darkness, Justice Arman becomes D&D’s new design director, and a new Google feature allows you to prioritise Geek Native as your news source.
